name: duckdb_query
description:
Runs one read-only SQL statement (SELECT, WITH, FROM, EXPLAIN, DESCRIBE, SHOW, SUMMARIZE) with DuckDB. Tables: one per data file in data.duckdb.dir (orders.csv is orders), in a sandbox without file or URL access.
Returns {query, columns, rows, row_count, execution_time_ms, limited}: rows are objects keyed by column; query is the text run.
Inputs (* required): sql_query* (one statement; DDL, DML, COPY, ATTACH and multiple statements are refused), limit (1-10000; default 100; appended as LIMIT when the query has none and caps the rows returned), output_format (json, csv or table; currently ignored, rows are always JSON objects).
To discover tables use duckdb_list_tables and duckdb_describe_table; for grouped totals without SQL duckdb_aggregate.
Example: {"sql_query": "SELECT region, COUNT(*) AS orders FROM orders GROUP BY region ORDER BY orders DESC", "limit": 20}

sql_query.description: SQL query to execute. Tables available: customers, orders, products (auto-created from CSV files in data directory)

limit.description: Maximum number of rows to return

query.description: The SQL query that was executed

rows.description: Query results as array of rows

limited.description: Whether results were limited by the limit parameter

metadata.author: Ashutosh Sinha
metadata.note: Execute analytical SQL queries with DuckDB. Tables are auto-created from CSV files: customers, orders, products.

input.sql_query: SELECT customer_segment, COUNT(*) as count, customer_tier FROM customers GROUP BY customer_segment, customer_tier ORDER BY count DESC
SELECT region, SUM(quantity * unit_price) as total_revenue FROM orders GROUP BY region ORDER BY total_revenue DESC

SELECT c.customer_name, c.customer_tier, SUM(o.quantity * o.unit_price) as total_spent FROM customers c JOIN orders o ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name, c.customer_tier ORDER BY total_spent DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT strftime(order_date::DATE, '%Y-%m') as month, SUM(quantity * unit_price) as revenue, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM orders GROUP BY month ORDER BY month
